findings.text: the environment probe asserts jax backend and x64 but never asserts which tree the replay imported, so "ran at the merged head" rests on PYTHONPATH=$W plus cwd alone; this section's own earlier base-suite reading was invalidated by exactly this class of sys.path resolution and was repaired by asserting the imported module file, and the same one-line marker (nova.__file__ under the worktree) is missing here, so the node's central claim is constructed rather than probed.

the before/after comparison that carries the reading ("compared against the committed receipt with the worktree path normalised out, every value that moves moves at 1e-16 relative") was computed in the worker's session and is not a lane step, so no cited log contains it; the claim is true (this review reproduced it independently) but a reader cannot open the measurement the reading depends on.

the sentence "Every value that moves moves at 1e-16 relative ... and no label, primary, class or disposition moves" is stated exhaustively but omits per-row wall_seconds (row 0 79.34 s to 47.00 s, a 41 percent move) and reads a relative metric onto primary position residuals, whose moves are up to 49 times in relative terms while staying at or below 1.2e-15 m absolute; the physical claim holds, but the sentence as written is falsifiable by its own artifact and should say absolute for the residuals and name the wall times.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 2998d370d; 88b96466 replaces receipt leaves only (path keys, 78 numeric values at the float64 roundoff floor, 12 wall_seconds) with no label, index, class or disposition moved, and 0b496fe3 adds three record paragraphs and two figure embeds -- no source file, test file, plan meta line or fence-external path in either.
item_verdicts.done_when: every quantity the done_when names is present in the artifact itself -- row_count 12, replayed_row_count 12, unavailable_row_count 0, marginal_unknown_row_count 0, pending_replayable_row_count 0, differing_cells empty on every row, both selected primaries matching on every row, status complete, passes true, cache sha256 dacb1776, one all_debug allocation (sacct job 1275959, COMPLETED, 00:02:22), and the suite count printed (9 passed in 7.44s).
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to rerun the twelve-row parity harness at the merged main head so the section-4 receipt reflects the adopted null generator, and docs/figures/hex-cell-single-grid/topology-parity.json (commit 88b96466) is regenerated at 2998d370d, whose ancestry carries the adoption commits ee17f957, 2e38dc87 and 233c56a3 that the pre-adoption base edc04e8c lacks, so the rerun measured a different read rather than repeating the old one.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records both commits, the gate command with its exit status, the 9-passed suite and the receipt's headline counts, and it names the missing run-revision field as a follow-on instead of claiming the receipt carries it.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the two commits touch only docs/figures/hex-cell-single-grid/topology-parity.json, docs/plans/plasma-cell-topology-authority.html and docs/evidence/archive/plasma-cell-topology-authority-landed.html, all inside the five declared write paths, and the lane logs are written inside the fenced reports directory.

justifications.durability: no test stands in the diff and nothing in nova/ or tests/ reads docs/figures/hex-cell-single-grid/topology-parity.json (only benchmarks/topology_parity_harness.py:44 writes it), so the artifact itself is unguarded; what does guard the machinery is the committed 9-test suite at tests/test_topology_parity_harness.py, which fails on an absorbed one-cell difference and on an unread marginal flag, one node removed from this change.
justifications.evidence: the receipt's own numbers were re-derived from the artifact and the headed logs rather than from the manifest -- row_count 12, zero differing cells on all twelve rows, cache sha256 dacb1776 matching the bank on disk, matching primaries and class on every row -- and sacct confirms job 1275959 on all_debug; docked because the before/after comparison the reading rests on has no cited log and the merged-head claim rests on the PYTHONPATH construction without an imported-module marker.
justifications.fit: the node runs the production read (ForwardFluxOperator._fixed_design_read on cached cell polygons) unmodified and writes no new code or name; its lane obeys the compute rules (one all_debug allocation, sbatch not srun, TMPDIR=/tmp in the submit environment and the payload, the root interpreter run directly, no uv on the compute node, --mem=64G) and the regenerated figure is byte-identical to the committed one (1819995 bytes, unchanged in the index), so the plotting rules already reviewed for that figure are unaffected.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the receipt at docs/figures/hex-cell-single-grid/topology-parity.json is regenerated at 2998d370d (main after 80e15f7fb) and reproduces the pre-adoption replay to float64 roundoff across 13,068 cells, which is the section's verification re-measurement landed as the goal states; docked one because the artifact names the bank's base revision (ee2ad2d6) and not the revision the read ran at, a gap the record discloses rather than absorbs.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --name-only over 88b96466 and 0b496fe3 lists exactly the three files the manifest names, all inside the declared fence, and the harness and its test file are byte-unchanged between 80e15f7fb and this node's head.
